ValidationRule.description: Asset Name cannot be editable by any profile other than Integration
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( $Setup.NSP_Trigger_Switch__c.NSP_AssetValidations__c ) , NOT( CONTAINS( $Profile.Name , 'System Admin' ) ) , $Profile.Name <> 'Integration User' , NOT( ISNEW() ) , OR( RecordType.Name = "CPQ Asset" , RecordType.Name = "WO" , RecordType.Name = "RET WO" ) , ISCHANGED( Name ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Asset name can only be edited by integration
